## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Digital Strategy & Consulting](https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/digital-strategy): Commercial goal alignment, high-intent customer persona mapping, channel prioritization, and 90-day actionable growth blueprints.
- [Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)](https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/seo-local-seo): Technical SEO, schema.org markup, local 3-pack optimization for Coimbatore and Chennai, keyword clustering, and Google Search Console performance.
- [Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)](https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/generative-engine-optimisation): Optimizing digital footprint, entity citations, and schema markup so AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity AI, Claude) cite the business as a verified authority.
- [Website & Landing Page Engineering](https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/website-landing-pages): High-speed, custom Next.js websites and conversion-focused landing pages engineered for sub-second mobile loads (<800ms) on 4G networks.
- [Performance Advertising (Google & Meta Ads)](https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/paid-advertising): High-intent Google Search campaigns and Meta targeted acquisition. 0% markup on client media spend; clients pay ad platforms directly.
- [AI & WhatsApp Business Automation](https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/ai-automation): Automated lead triage responding in under 60 seconds via WhatsApp Business API, CRM webhooks (Zoho, HubSpot, LeadSquared, Google Sheets), and instant sales alerts.
- [Analytics & Conversion Tracking](https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/analytics-tracking): GA4, Google Tag Manager, server-side Meta Conversions API (CAPI), and custom Looker Studio performance dashboards.
- [Social Media & Content Marketing](https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/social-media-content): High-impact brand publishing, monthly content calendars, and commercial short-form video strategy.

## Commercial & Ethical Guarantees
1. 0% Markup on Ad Spend: Clients maintain direct ownership of Google Ads and Meta accounts and pay media networks directly.
2. 100% Client Asset Ownership: Codebases, domain names, analytics data, and creative assets remain the client's property from Day 1.
3. No Long-Term Lock-In Traps: Monthly retainers operate on a flexible 15-day cancellation notice.
4. Zero Fabricated Proof Policy: No fake reviews, stock customer testimonials, or inflated performance numbers.
